title: Judelow Totem Reskin (SFX)
description: Reskins the minecraft totem of undying to look like Judelow (with custom sounds)
body:
# Judelow Totem Reskin #
This is a simple resourcepack that changes the totem of undying to look like the youtuber Judelow.

This version of the pack adds a custom sound effect for when your totem activates.

Hope you enjoy this pack :>
